editorial:
You follow Maxine Minx, an adult film star chasing a real acting break in 1980s Hollywood, while a mysterious killer starts picking off young starlets across the city. The movie mixes slasher tension with flashy retro style, so you get neon lights, big hair, synth music, and plenty of danger around every corner. It feels like a wild night out where every scene could turn bloody, and Maxine’s hunger for fame keeps pulling you deeper into the chaos.

Mia Goth carries the film with fierce energy, and the supporting cast keeps things lively from scene to scene. The pacing moves fast, though some twists feel a bit messy and the gore can be intense for sensitive viewers. If you enjoy stylish horror with a strong lead and a retro mood, you will have a good time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Maxine learns the starlet killer is tied to her past and confronts the man hunting her at the Hollywood sign. She fights back, kills him, and escapes police suspicion by using the chaos to her advantage. The last shot shows her stepping into stardom, proving her ruthless drive won out, with her dark secret still buried beneath her new fame.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish slasher movies with a fierce lead.
